name: Northwest Territories: public health coverage for newcomers
name_fr: Territoires du Nord-Ouest : assurance maladie publique pour les nouveaux arrivants
description: Who is covered by NWT Health Care Plan by immigration status, any waiting period for newcomers, how to apply, the public drug-coverage model and the share of adults with a regular health care provider.

attributes.legal_status: in force (eligibility rules as published on the access date)

eligibility_by_status.citizen: Eligible as a resident (residency and presence rules apply).
eligibility_by_status.permanent_resident: Eligible if lawfully entitled to be in Canada, making a home in the NWT and present at least 153 days a year.
eligibility_by_status.work_permit_holder: Conflicting official material: a 2018 booklet excludes temporary workers; the current application form accepts a work permit; the current page says to contact the Health Services Administration Office.
eligibility_by_status.study_permit_holder: Contact the Health Services Administration Office.
eligibility_by_status.visitor: Visitors and tourists are expressly excluded in the AB, MB, NB and PE material read; treat visitors as not covered everywhere and confirm locally.

attributes.status_dependency: Which rule applies depends on the user's immigration status, which is unknown (USER-PROFILE.md: 'Citizenship(s) and current country of residence', 'Existing Canadian status or application').

newcomer_waiting_period.arriving_from_outside_canada: Coverage effective on arrival for non-citizens moving from outside Canada, per a 2018 HSS booklet (older source).
newcomer_waiting_period.moving_from_another_province: First day of the third month after the month of arrival.

attributes.how_to_apply: Through the Health Services Administration Office.
attributes.drug_coverage_model: The NWT Health Care Plan does not cover drugstore medicines; Extended Health Benefits programs apply to specified groups.

regular_provider.source: CIHI indicator 'Canadians With a Primary Health Care Provider', Statistics Canada CCHS

sources.title: NWT Health Care Plan — general information for residents (read through search-engine extract)
sources.publisher: Government of the Northwest Territories, Health and Social Services

sources.title: Canadians With a Primary Health Care Provider — indicator data table (data updated October 2026); underlying data: Statistics Canada, Canadian Community Health Survey, Annual Component
sources.methodology: Weighted percent of adults 18+ reporting a regular/primary health care provider (family doctor, nurse practitioner or other); 95% confidence interval given. 2025 adult questions were harmonized, so compare with earlier years with caution.

sources.title: Public Drug Plan Designs, 2021/22 edition (describes 2020/21 plan designs; page modified 2024-01-30)

verification.notes: Provincial page(s) fetched directly where status is 'verified'; otherwise some content came from search-engine extracts of official pages (403 or bot-check on fetch). Regular-provider figures parsed from CIHI's published data table.

limitations: Eligibility text summarises official pages and is not legal advice; temporary-status rules change often. Drug-plan designs are from PMPRB's 2020/21 summary and may be out of date. 'Without a regular provider' is 100 minus the CIHI share (simple arithmetic). Territorial provider figure is for 2024 with a wide confidence interval.
